title: Two Members of Highline Public Schools Community in King County, Washington Reportedly Targeted in Deepfake Kidnapping Scam

behaviors.text: Scammers allegedly used AI-generated voice cloning technology to convincingly mimic the voices of their family members.
Two members of the a person community in Burien, a town in King County, Washington, were reportedly targeted in a deepfake kidnapping scam.
The scammers reportedly used the altered voices to claim they had been kidnapped and demanding a ransom be paid.
